relationships.subject: KOR-expressing ACC neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Together, the data show that chemogenetic inhibition of KOR-expressing neurons in the ACC is sufficient to promote negative affect and sleep disruption, i.e., sleep fragmentation, in the absence of neuropathic injury.

relationships.subject: KOR
relationships.evidence_quote: ACC KOR CRISPR editing significantly reduced the number of wake and NREM episodes

relationships.subject: KOR
relationships.evidence_quote: KOR deletion prevented the CPP induced by gabapentin in mice with PSNL injury

key_findings: Chemogenetic Gi inhibition of KOR-expressing ACC neurons produced aversion and sleep fragmentation in naive mice.
CRISPR deletion of ACC KOR normalized PSNL-induced negative affect and sleep fragmentation but preserved allodynia.
